Narrative and Plans ,
For 1051 W Cornelia Ave
From RT-4 to RM-5

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from RT-4 to RM-S5 to meet the bulk and
density requirements of the RM-5 to allow a roof top addition to the existing 3
story 4 dwelling unit building with 4 on-site parking spaces.

a) Floor Area Ratio 1.40
Building Area 7,800 SQ. FT.

b) Density (MLA) Lot Area per D.U. 1,401.25 SQ. FT. (4 D.U.’S)
Lot Area 5,605 SQ.FT.

c) Building Height *49°-2" (MAX HT 47’-0”)

d) Existing Setbacks
Front Setback 11.92 FT (EXISTING)
Rear Setback 37.63 FT (EXISTING)
East Side Setback 4.89 FT (EXISTING)
West Side Setback 6.08 FT (EXISTING)

e) Parking 4 SPACES (EXISTING)

* Applicant will seek other zoning relief as needed to comply with the proposed building
height.
